registers.name: GICD_TYPER2
registers.description: Interrupt Controller Type Register 2。GIC Distributor 寄存器

fields.name: nASSGIcap
fields.description: 指示是否 SGIs can be configured to not have an 活跃状态. This bit is RES0 on 实现 that support two Security states. [0b0=SGIs have an 活跃状态. ; 0b1=SGIs can be globally configured not to have an 活跃状态.]

fields.name: VIL
fields.description: [当 GICv4.1 is implemented] 指示是否 16 bits of vPEID are implemented. [0b0=GIC supports 16-bit vPEID. ; 0b1=GIC supports GICD_TYPER2.VID + 1 bits of vPEID.]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: VID
fields.description: [当 GICD_TYPER2.VIL == '1'] The 位数 vPEID. [0b00000..0b01111=The 的个数 vPEID bits implemented, minus one.]；否则为 RES0
